title: Keep a session's pull request history across branches, restarts and cloud runtimes
prompt:
The PR panel finds a session's pull requests only by its current branch, so a session that moves to a follow-up branch loses its earlier PRs, a restart forgets them, and two sessions sharing a branch import each other's PRs. A session's PRs should come from recorded evidence (the PRs it created, adopted or discovered), saved with the repository they belong to. Branch discovery only says which recorded PR is the current one. That evidence has to work for local checkouts first, then for cloud workspaces, where the runtime holds the evidence, and finally for older cloud runtimes that cannot report it.

Build this on top of the existing GitSource (src/lib/gitSource.ts), `gh` (src/lib/api.ts) and RemoteGit (packages/portable/src/workspaceGit.ts).

In src/lib/api.ts:
- `type PrScope = { kind: "local"; cwd: string } | { kind: "cloud"; workspace: string; repo: string }` and `interface PrAssociation { url; number; head; scope: PrScope }`.
- `gh.associations(sessionId, additions = [])` invokes `"pr_associations"` with `{ sessionKey: sessionId, additions }`, saving the additions and returning every saved association for the session.
- `gh.details`, `gh.ready` and `gh.merge` take an optional PR `url` and pass it as `url`, as in `invoke("pr_details", { cwd, number, url })`, `invoke("pr_ready", { cwd, number, url })` and `invoke("pr_merge", { cwd, number, url, method })`. `gh.create` takes an optional `sessionId` and passes it to `"pr_create"` as `{ cwd, title, body, base, draft, sessionId }`.

In src/lib/gitSource.ts, GitSource gains:
- `prAccess(association)`, which returns `{ read(), ready(), merge(method) }` for that saved PR. Local sources go through the native commands with the association's number and url. Cloud sources use a RemoteGit for the association's `scope.repo`: `read()` calls `git.prs` with `{ repo, branch: head, number }` and picks the PR with the same URL; `ready()` calls the `git.prReady` mutation.
- `createPr` takes an optional `sessionId`. A cloud creation saves its association right away through `gh.associations(sessionId, [{ url, number, head, scope: { kind: "cloud", workspace, repo: remote.repo } }])`.
- For cloud sources, `prAssociations(sessionId)`. The session key must belong to the source's workspace; otherwise throw an error whose message contains "different cloud workspace", before any request. It reads the runtime's `git.prAssociations` (RemoteGit gains `prAssociations(sessionId)` with the runtime session id, `prs(branch?, number?)` and `prLanded()`), saves each answer under its own repository scope through `gh.associations`, and returns `{ associations }`. When the runtime answers `method_not_found`, return the cached associations with `discoveryOnly: true`. Any other error code is rethrown.
- `landed()` exists for a cloud source only when it can write. It returns null on `method_not_found` and rethrows other errors.

New src/lib/sessionPrs.ts exports `interface SessionPr { identity; association?; pr?; current: boolean; error? }`, `prIdentity(url)` (lowercased, no trailing slash) and `sessionPrs(source, sessionId, branch, isCurrent = () => true): Promise<{ rows; error? }>`:
- It runs discovery for the branch first, then reads associations, so evidence recorded during discovery is included. If `isCurrent()` turns false at any point, it returns no rows and saves nothing.
- A discovered PR becomes a row only when it is recorded for the session, except in discovery-only mode, where branch PRs are shown without an association. Rows are deduplicated by identity and marked `current` only when discovery returned them. Each recorded PR not seen in discovery is refreshed through `prAccess(...).read()`. A failure there stays on that row as `error`, and the other rows are unaffected.
- A discovery failure becomes `error`. In discovery-only mode, `error` says to "Update the workspace runtime".
- Open PRs come first, then higher numbers first.

Use `sessionPrs` in src/components/changes/PrPanel.tsx in place of the branch-only lookup.
notes:
Source: PR #620, five commits, all on the same PR-history path.
Chain: 8f2bd8f9 introduces src/lib/sessionPrs.ts, PrAssociation and the pr_associations registry, and adds prAccess to GitSource. cf745743 changes sessionPrs.ts, gitSource.ts and PrPanel.tsx to recover creation evidence. 9a9a46de rewrites sessionPrs() so that recorded evidence, not a shared branch, decides ownership. 305c536c gives the cloud GitSource prAssociations/prScope on top of the new RemoteGit methods and edits sessionPrs.ts. 9e288a47 changes gitSource.ts and sessionPrs.ts to tolerate method_not_found as discovery-only.
Every later commit edits sessionPrs()/gitSource functions the first commit introduced.
The check is the PR's sessionPrs unit test. The PrPanel UI test is left out because it depends on exact labels.
